column1: Quarantine — do NOT cite without checking each one yourself

These are entries the second AI included with 'Unknown / verify' authors or wrong metadata, plus post-cutoff items. I checked each by live search on 15 Jul 2026. Verdicts below. Keep them OUT of the main corpus until confirmed.
'GhostWriter: Persistent Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents' (author Unknown/verify)
column3: Zero search hits for this title. Almost certainly hallucinated. Remove. If you want a real dormant-poisoning cite, use Trojan Hippo, Sleeper (Pulipaka), or Zombie Agents instead.

column1: 'ElephantAgent: Long-Lived Memory Integrity for LLM Agents' (Unknown/verify)
column3: Zero search hits. Remove. For long-lived memory integrity, cite MemOS or MemLineage.

column1: 'When Claws Remember but Do Not Tell: MemGhost / Whisper' (Unknown/verify)
column3: No such paper found; the 'Claw' phrasing echoes ClawSafety (a different, real paper). Remove.

column1: 'Temporal Dynamics of Memory Poisoning in Web3-Style LLM...' — IEEE Access (Unknown/verify)
column3: No matching IEEE Access record found. Do not cite. If you need temporal-dynamics, use STALE (arXiv:2605.06527) or PersistBench.

column1: 'DrunkAgent: Memory-Centred Attacks on LLM Agents' — ACM proceedings (Unknown/verify)
column3: Real paper = 'DrunkAgent: Stealthy Memory Corruption in LLM-Powered RECOMMENDER Agents' (arXiv:2503.23804, ACM Web Conf 2026). It's recommender-specific. Cite with correct title/scope or omit.

column1: 'Hijacking Agent Memory: Persistent Poisoning of Long-Term...' (Unknown/verify)
column3: Real paper = 'Hijacking Agent Memory: Stealthy Trojan Attacks Through Conversational Interaction' (method: MemPoison, arXiv:2605.29960). Now in the verified corpus with correct metadata.

column1: 'Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forensic-Aware...FARMA/SENTINEL' (Unknown/verify)

Dated Jul 2026 — AFTER the survey's 13 Jul cutoff AND both AIs' training cutoffs. Highly relevant (forged reasoning traces). If you cite it, note it as very recent and verify details yourself.
